description: History of the operations done on the seller's outposts (seller × marketplace): bid/budget changes, price changes, listing fixes, etc., with who did them (user, ai, session), value before → after and, when already evaluated, the measured impact on the KPI (outcome migliorato/neutro/peggiorato/non_valutabile). Newest first. outpost_id filters one outpost (see list_clients); without it lists every outpost the user can see. Use it before proposing a change to know what was already tried and how it went.

outpost_id.description: Outpost (seller × marketplace) id; omit for all visible outposts.

name: list_action_log
